q: You walk inside a very old Christian church with high ceilings, large stained-glass windows, and a bishop's seat in the city center.
why: Cathedral — katta va asosiy xristian ibodatxonasi. «Christian church» va «bishop's seat» so'zlari buni ko'rsatadi.

q: Visitors can walk among thousands of exotic plants, palm trees, and rare flowers in this huge public garden.
why: Botanical gardens — o'simliklar o'stiriladigan bog'. «exotic plants» va «flowers» so'zlari ishora qiladi.

wrong.national park: National park — tabiatni muhofaza qiluvchi katta hudud.
wrong.water park: Water park — suv havzalari va slaydlari bor joy.

q: We bought fresh vegetables, spices, and local bread from friendly sellers at the busy outdoor trading area.
why: Market — bozor, savdo joyi. «bought fresh vegetables» va «sellers» ishora qiladi.

q: Many huge ships and small fishing boats stay safely in this sheltered coastal area.
why: Harbour — kema porti. «ships and small fishing boats» va «coastal area» ishora qiladi.

wrong.market: Market — oziq-ovqat va buyumlar sotiladigan bozor.

q: You can see ancient stone walls, broken columns, and remains of a Roman settlement from two thousand years ago.
why: Ruins — vayronalar, harobalar. «ancient stone walls» va «broken columns» so'zlari buni bildiradi.

q: Water shoots high up into the air from this decorative stone structure in the middle of the town square.
why: Fountain — favvora. «Water shoots high up into the air» iborasi buni tasdiqlaydi.

q: We rode exciting roller coasters and ate sweet cotton candy all afternoon at the fun amusement area.
why: Theme park — attraksionlar parki. «exciting roller coasters» va «cotton candy» ishora qiladi.

wrong.water park: Water park — faqat suv o'yinlari joyi.

q: We looked at hundreds of colorful tropical fish, sharks, and giant sea turtles swimming in huge glass tanks.
why: Aquarium — okeanarium, baliqlar maskani. «tropical fish, sharks» va «glass tanks» ishora qiladi.

wrong.water park: Water park — odamlar cho'miladigan suv parki.

q: The stone walls and heavy iron gates of this medieval fortress reminded us of brave knights and kings.
why: Castle — qasr, qal'a. «medieval fortress» va «knights and kings» iboralari ishora qiladi.

q: Muslims come to this beautiful building with a large dome and a tall minaret to pray every day.
why: Mosque — masjid. «Muslims» va «dome and a tall minaret» so'zlari buni bildiradi.

q: We saw a bronze sculpture of a famous national poet riding a horse in the central park.
why: Statue — haykal. «bronze sculpture of a famous national poet» so'zlari buni tasdiqlaydi.

q: We visited an amazing ______ filled with ancient paintings, swords, and royal clothes from the 14th century.
why: Museum — muzey. «filled with ancient paintings and swords» iborasi buni ko'rsatadi.

q: The grand royal ______ had shiny gold ceilings, crystal chandeliers, and a massive ballroom for kings.
why: Palace — saroy. «gold ceilings and crystal chandeliers» shohona saroyni bildiradi.

q: We went sliding down giant water tubes and swimming in the wave pool at the new outdoor ______.
why: Water park — akvapark. «water tubes and swimming in the wave pool» ishora qiladi.

q: Animals like bears, wolves, and eagles live safely in their natural habitat inside this huge ______.
why: National park — milliy bog', qo'riqxona. «natural habitat» va «animals live safely» ishora qiladi.

q: The old mountain village had a very ______ feel with misty mornings, quiet stone streets, and old lamps.
why: Atmospheric — o'ziga xos muhitga boy. «misty mornings and quiet stone streets» muhitni tasvirlaydi.

q: The sunset over the blue lake and green mountains was truly ______, like a postcard picture.
why: Beautiful — go'zal, chiroyli. «sunset over the blue lake» va «postcard picture» so'zlari ishora qiladi.

q: There was nothing to do in the small village all day, so we felt completely ______.
why: Boring — zerikarli. «nothing to do in the small village» iborasi shuni ko'rsatadi.

q: The main shopping street was very ______ on Saturday, with thousands of people walking and buying things.
why: Busy — gavjum, odam ko'p. «thousands of people walking» iborasi buni tasdiqlaydi.

q: Samarkand is a wonderfully ______ city with famous mosques, madrasas, and monuments from the Silk Road.
why: Historic — tarixiy. «famous mosques, madrasas, and monuments from the Silk Road» ishora qiladi.
